brief:
Germany's Foreign Ministry expressed regret over Israel's military closure of an investigation into a 2024 attack on vehicles belonging to the World Central Kitchen aid organization in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The ministry called for those responsible to be held accountable.

The attack targeted World Central Kitchen staff members operating in the territory. Germany's statement came as Israel's military announced it had concluded its inquiry into the incident without pursuing criminal charges against officials involved in the strike.

The closure of the investigation drew criticism from the German government, which pressed for further action to establish responsibility for the deaths of the aid workers killed in the operation.
